description: Use when an agent must understand a picture (screenshot, product photo, chart, scene). Input: url of a png, jpeg, webp or gif (max 5 MB), optional question (max 1000 chars), optional json=true for fields (objects, text, people count, colors...). Output: answer or fields, image info, model. Does not name people; exact text: /v1/convert/ocr. Not stored. Example: ?url=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/4/47/PNG_transparency_demonstration_1.png Price: $0.006 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

json.description: true returns structured fields instead of free text

question.description: What to ask about the image (default: a detailed description)

url.description: Public http(s) image URL (png, jpeg, webp, gif; max 5 MB). Bad or private URL → 400 before payment; non-image → 422, not charged

name: ai_vision
title: Image understanding: describe an image, answer a question about it, or return structured fields (open vision model)
